name: ferrum-nexus
description: Multi-user developer portal and workflow layer for Ferrum Edge.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.lint: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
